name: loop-error-raw-durable
about: 模型错误 details.raw 的落盘形状。基线 normalizeModelError（model/errors/normalizeModelError.ts:32,58）把抛出的 Error 对象本身放进 raw；实时投影（providerError.raw）用 JSON.stringify 看到它的自有字段，会话记录写入前 JsonlTranscriptWriter（session/transcript/JsonlTranscriptWriter.ts:193,300）先 structuredClone 整条记录，任何 Error 实例都被克隆成只剩不可枚举 message/stack 的普通 Error，落盘为 {}；provider 回的 JSON 错误体是普通对象，原样保留。e1：流发出一块后断开（TypeError: terminated 一类，重试用尽）；e2：provider 地址连不上（NetworkFetchError）；e3：400 JSON 错误体（raw 保留错误体）；e4：流一块不发就停住（NetworkFetchError network_timeout）。retry 次数设 0、退避设小。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        requestMaxRetries: 0
        streamMaxRetries: 0
        streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    dead:
      protocol: openai
      url: http://127.0.0.1:1/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        requestMaxRetries: 0
        streamMaxRetries: 0
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
